from math import ceil

liked_ids=set()
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('liked_page', page_index, 'count', len(resp) if resp else 0)
    if not resp:
        break
    for s in resp:
        liked_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    page_index += 1
print('total_liked_songs', len(liked_ids))

print('have access_token', 'access_token' in globals())
print('liked_ids size', len(liked_ids))

user_email='brenda.webe@gmail.com'
page_index=0
page_limit=20
not_liked_count=0
updated_count=0
created_count=0
skipped_already1=0
songs_processed=0

while True:
    lib_resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('library_page', page_index, 'count', len(lib_resp) if lib_resp else 0)
    if not lib_resp:
        break
    for song in lib_resp:
        songs_processed += 1
        sid=song['song_id']
        if sid in liked_ids:
            continue
        not_liked_count += 1
        # fetch existing reviews for this song by user
        r_page=0
        user_reviews=[]
        while True:
            rr = apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid, user_email=user_email, page_index=r_page, page_limit=20)
            if not rr:
                break
            user_reviews.extend(rr)
            r_page += 1
        if not user_reviews:
            # create review with rating 1
            cr = apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=sid, rating=1, access_token=access_token)
            created_count += 1
            continue
        # update any reviews with rating >1 (or !=1?) as per instruction higher than 1
        max_rating = max(rv.get('rating',1) for rv in user_reviews)
        if max_rating > 1:
            # update first review with rating !=1 maybe all
            for rv in user_reviews:
                if rv.get('rating',1) > 1:
                    apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=rv['song_review_id'], access_token=access_token, rating=1)
                    updated_count += 1
        else:
            skipped_already1 += 1
    page_index += 1

print('songs_processed', songs_processed)
print('not_liked_count', not_liked_count)
print('created_count', created_count)
print('updated_count', updated_count)
print('skipped_already1', skipped_already1)

# Verify all not-liked library songs now have max rating == 1
user_email='brenda.webe@gmail.com'
# rebuild library songs and compute those not liked
liked_ids=set(liked_ids)  # use existing
not_liked_songs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    lib_resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not lib_resp:
        break
    for song in lib_resp:
        if song['song_id'] not in liked_ids:
            not_liked_songs.append(song['song_id'])
    page_index += 1

bad=[]
for sid in not_liked_songs:
    # fetch user reviews pages
    r_page=0
    user_reviews=[]
    while True:
        rr = apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid, user_email=user_email, page_index=r_page, page_limit=20)
        if not rr:
            break
        user_reviews.extend(rr)
        r_page += 1
    if not user_reviews:
        bad.append((sid,'no_review'))
    else:
        max_rating=max(rv.get('rating',1) for rv in user_reviews)
        if max_rating!=1:
            bad.append((sid,'max_rating',max_rating,'reviews',[(rv['rating'],rv['song_review_id']) for rv in user_reviews]))

print('not_liked_songs',len(not_liked_songs))
print('bad_count',len(bad))
print('bad',bad[:5])

# Task completed; mark in supervisor
apis.supervisor.complete_task()
